queries: WITH g AS (SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) AS tp, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS al FROM results res JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId GROUP BY r.name), a AS (SELECT AVG(tp) AS avg_tp FROM g) SELECT SUM(g.tp) AS total_points, AVG(g.al) AS avg_of_avg_laps, AVG(g.tp - a.avg_tp) AS avg_excess FROM g CROSS JOIN a WHERE g.tp > a.avg_tp

WITH t AS (SELECT ra.name, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(r.laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps FROM results r JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY ra.name), a AS (SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_total FROM t) SELECT SUM(t.total_points) AS sum_total_points, AVG(t.avg_laps) AS avg_of_avg_laps, AVG(t.total_points - a.avg_total) AS avg_excess FROM t, a WHERE t.total_points > a.avg_total

assumptions.assumption: The average total is the plain average of per-race-name totals across all race names (those with results), and 'laps' (stored as text) is cast to a number for averaging.

assumptions.assumption: results.laps is stored as text and is cast to a number for averaging; each race name (not each race instance) is one group, so the same-named races across years are combined.
The average of totals is taken over all race names that have results (inner join), including those with NULL-free totals only as computed.
